statement: A head behind its base must carry a merge commit of the base: a PR commit whose non-first parent is the merge base of base...head (what `git merge <remote>/<base>` leaves).
note: Seeded by scripts/model seed-rules (PADRAO-DEV F1b); its statement and types are to be reviewed. Basis: D-070 (f) decides it: the P-G3 relaxation of the base-merge requirement goes behind a registry switch (merge.tier1_requires_base_merge), and "Merge commits only, no rebase, stays". Built by unit FP1 (docs/units/FP1, 27/10) after D-070 the same day.
